brainlife.desc: Experimental: per-streamline or per-timepoint labels as index.csv with names.csv, e.g. SIFT survivors or connectome node-pair assignments.
brainlife.name: neuro/labels
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Filtering streamlines or converting node-pair assignments into tract classifications.

**Not for:** Use with a tractogram other than the one the labels were computed on.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 5 Apps, output of 3 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.labels.json

files.desc: CSV of one label value per streamline (or time point).
CSV naming each label value (e.g. node pairs).

identifying_risks: Low on its own; identifying only together with the matching tractogram
